name: Pangolin
tagline: The only mammal covered in scales, and the most trafficked one on Earth.
heroAlt: A pangolin walking across dry ground at dusk, its overlapping keratin scales catching the low light

name: Fennec Fox
tagline: The smallest fox alive, built almost entirely around its ears.
heroAlt: A fennec fox on pale desert sand at golden hour with its enormous ears held upright

name: Capybara
tagline: The largest rodent on Earth, and improbably calm about everything.
heroAlt: A capybara at the edge of a river in soft morning light with reeds behind it

name: Narwhal
tagline: An Arctic whale whose tusk is really a tooth grown through its lip.
heroAlt: A narwhal at the surface among Arctic sea ice with its long spiral tusk clear of the water

name: Aye-Aye
tagline: A nocturnal lemur that hunts grubs by tapping on wood and listening.
heroAlt: An aye-aye clinging to a branch at night, its huge orange eyes reflecting the light

name: Giraffe
tagline: The famous oversized heart is a myth. What is actually going on is stranger.
heroAlt: An adult giraffe standing in profile on open savanna with its neck raised and acacia trees behind

name: Slow Loris
tagline: The only venomous primate, and the reason is a gland in its elbow.
heroAlt: A slow loris gripping a branch at night in rainforest, its large round eyes reflecting the light

name: African Elephant
tagline: Most of an elephant herd’s conversation happens below what you can hear.
heroAlt: An African elephant standing on open savanna at golden hour with its ears spread and trunk lowered

name: Three-Toed Sloth
tagline: It climbs all the way down once a week to defecate, and it often dies doing it.
heroAlt: A three-toed sloth hanging beneath a branch in rainforest canopy with its long curved claws hooked over the wood

name: Gray Wolf
tagline: There is no alpha wolf. The researcher who popularised the idea spent years retracting it.
heroAlt: A grey wolf standing in snow at the edge of conifer forest, looking directly toward the camera

name: Lion
tagline: The only cat that lives in a group, and the females run it.
heroAlt: A male lion lying on open savanna grass at golden hour, mane full, looking into the distance

name: Tiger
tagline: Every wild tiger left would fit inside one small town.
heroAlt: A wild tiger walking through tall grass at the edge of forest, striped flank catching the light

name: Serval
tagline: The cat built like a radio dish on stilts.
heroAlt: A serval standing alert in tall savanna grass with its oversized ears raised

name: Rhinoceros
tagline: The horn is not ivory and not bone. It is the same protein as your fingernails.
heroAlt: A rhinoceros standing in open grassland in profile, its horn and heavy folded skin clearly visible

name: Wombat
tagline: The only animal that produces cube-shaped droppings, and it does it on purpose.
heroAlt: A wombat standing at the entrance to its burrow on grassy ground, stocky body and broad nose visible

name: Honey Badger
tagline: Loose skin, a bad attitude, and genuine resistance to cobra venom.
heroAlt: A honey badger walking across dry ground, its black body and broad white back stripe clearly visible

name: Platypus
tagline: Lays eggs, detects electricity, has venom, and glows under ultraviolet light.
heroAlt: A platypus swimming at the surface of a still river, its bill and dense brown fur visible

name: Wolverine
tagline: Thirty pounds of animal that drives bears off kills and crushes frozen bone.
heroAlt: A wolverine moving across deep snow in boreal forest, its dark coat and pale flank stripe visible

name: Thorny Devil
tagline: A desert lizard that drinks through its skin.
heroAlt: A thorny devil lizard walking across red desert sand, its conical spines catching the low sunlight

name: Panther Chameleon
tagline: Color that signals mood, not background, in a different palette per valley.
heroAlt: A male panther chameleon gripping a branch in Madagascan foliage, banded in turquoise and red

name: Gaboon Viper
tagline: The longest fangs of any snake, on an animal you will walk straight past.
heroAlt: A Gaboon viper resting in rainforest leaf litter, its geometric pattern blending into dead leaves

name: Green Anaconda
tagline: The heaviest snake alive, and almost helpless out of water.
heroAlt: A green anaconda partly submerged at the edge of a tropical river with only its head above water

name: Glass Frog
tagline: You can watch its heart beat through its own skin.
heroAlt: A glass frog on a backlit green leaf with its translucent underside showing internal organs

name: Blue Poison Dart Frog
tagline: Bright enough to be a warning, and only toxic because of what it eats.
heroAlt: A blue poison dart frog on a wet dark leaf, its cobalt skin marked with black spots

name: Axolotl
tagline: A salamander that never grows up, and regrows almost anything.
heroAlt: An axolotl in clear freshwater with its feathery external gills fanned out

name: Shoebill
tagline: A metre-tall bird that hunts by standing perfectly still for hours.
heroAlt: A shoebill standing among African wetland reeds with its enormous shoe-shaped bill in profile

name: Victoria Crowned Pigeon
tagline: A turkey-sized pigeon wearing a crown of lace.
heroAlt: A Victoria crowned pigeon walking on a rainforest floor showing its blue-grey plumage and lacy crest

name: Emperor Penguin
tagline: Penguins do not mate for life, and the huddle is a moving machine.
heroAlt: An emperor penguin standing on Antarctic sea ice in low light, its orange ear patches and pale bill visible

name: Crow
tagline: It remembers your face, holds a grudge, and tells other crows about you.
heroAlt: A crow perched on a bare branch against an overcast sky, its glossy black plumage and heavy bill visible

name: Giant Manta Ray
tagline: Seven metres across, filter-feeding, and one of the few fish to pass a mirror test.
heroAlt: A giant manta ray gliding through open blue water seen from below with sunlight above

name: Leafy Sea Dragon
tagline: A relative of the seahorse pretending, very convincingly, to be seaweed.
heroAlt: A leafy sea dragon among kelp with leaf-shaped appendages along its gold and green body

name: Bottlenose Dolphin
tagline: Every dolphin invents a name for itself and answers to it for life.
heroAlt: A bottlenose dolphin breaking the surface of open blue water with its beak and melon clear of the waterline

name: Clownfish
tagline: Every clownfish is born male, and the largest one becomes female.
heroAlt: A clownfish nestled among the tentacles of a sea anemone on a tropical reef

name: Immortal Jellyfish
tagline: It can run its own life cycle backwards, which is not the same as not dying.
heroAlt: A tiny transparent immortal jellyfish photographed against dark water, its red stomach visible through the bell

name: Seahorse
tagline: The male gets pregnant, and it is a real pregnancy, not just carrying eggs.
heroAlt: A seahorse gripping a strand of seagrass with its tail in clear shallow water

name: Sharks
tagline: Older than trees, older than Saturn’s rings, and barely a threat to anyone.
heroAlt: A shark cruising through open blue water seen from the side, with light rippling across its back

name: Octopus
tagline: Three hearts, blue blood, and most of its neurons outside its head.
heroAlt: An octopus on a rocky seabed with its arms curled beneath it and skin textured to match the rock

name: Mantis Shrimp
tagline: The famous eyes are real. The famous conclusion about them is wrong.
heroAlt: A peacock mantis shrimp at the mouth of its burrow on a reef, its green and orange shell and stalked eyes visible

name: Cuttlefish
tagline: It puts on the best colour display in the ocean and probably cannot see colour.
heroAlt: A cuttlefish hovering above sand with its arms held forward and a rippling pattern across its skin

name: Humpback Whale
tagline: Every male in an ocean sings the same song, and the song changes together.
heroAlt: A humpback whale breaching clear of the ocean surface with water streaming from its long pectoral fin
